entities.name: Vevey–Chexbres railway line
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Vevey–Puidoux-Chexbres railway line is a short, single-track standard gauge railway, connecting Vevey to Puidoux in the Swiss canton of Vaud. The line was built by the chemin de fer Vevey–Chexbres and is today owned and operated by Swiss Federal Railways.
